scope_note: This wave refreshes six legacy dossiers without discarding their long-form history. It removes unsupported live market snapshots, separates operator activity from NFT investment performance, and treats token or chain migrations as strategic choices rather than automatic evidence of success. Every lifecycle label has direct-current or terminal evidence; unverified market, holder, revenue, legal, and attribution claims remain explicit unknowns.

profile_patch.mint_price: 1 ETH public mint; aggregate proceeds not independently audited here

profile_patch.community_history: Azuki built a highly recognizable anime-native PFP community, then damaged trust twice: founder Zagabond disclosed involvement in three prior discontinued projects in May 2022, and the June 2023 Elementals sale drew complaints about duplicated-looking art and mint execution. Those events are documented; claims of fraud or a completed legal recovery are not established. By 2026 the operator had moved beyond roadmap language into a physical trading-card game, organized play, an app, retail-store distribution, and announced manga.
profile_patch.community_sentiment: Mixed rather than measurable as uniformly positive or negative. Earlier trust disputes remain material, while current TCG tournaments and retail distribution demonstrate participation outside secondary NFT trading. No representative holder-sentiment survey is available.
profile_patch.notable_holders: No current, independently verified named-holder roster is asserted. Public endorsements, pseudonymous wallets, and marketplace ownership are not treated as the same fact.
profile_patch.founder_engagement: Azuki Labs remains operational: its TCG team shipped Set 1, ran organized play, maintained a tournament app, and announced 2026 convention and manga activity. Historical credibility concerns around Zagabond and Elementals remain part of the risk record.
profile_patch.social: The project has an operating official TCG news and tournament surface. Follower totals and engagement quality are withheld because they were not captured through a reproducible longitudinal source.
profile_patch.benefits: The NFT community received a disclosed 37.5% ANIME allocation at token launch. The broader Azuki ecosystem now includes physical cards, organized play, an app, manga and merchandise; the reviewed sources do not prove that every product or prize is restricted to NFT holders.
profile_patch.business: Azuki has become an IP-and-products operator spanning NFTs, ANIME/Animecoin infrastructure, physical TCG products, organized play, merchandise and planned manga. Retail reach and shipped products are observable; unit economics, revenue, profitability and the share attributable to Azuki NFT ownership are not disclosed.
profile_patch.analysis: Middling reflects a genuine operating recovery but not a restored investment thesis. The strategic move from repeated NFT issuance toward a shipped TCG, retail distribution and story IP reduces dependence on floor price. It does not erase the Elementals execution failure, prove holder trust recovered, or establish current NFT liquidity, holder retention, revenue or profitability.

chain_dependence.finding: The original NFTs remain Ethereum assets, while Animecoin and the proposed AnimeChain broaden the stack through Ethereum/Arbitrum infrastructure. The physical TCG and manga reduce product dependence on any one chain but add conventional retail and IP execution risk.

why.finding: Azuki retained enough brand and team capacity to convert anime-native recognition into shipped physical and story products. Its limiting factor is not absence of activity but a trust deficit created by founder history and the Elementals launch, plus the still-unproven link between brand products and NFT-holder value.

strategic_choices.choice: Use a 10,000-item Ethereum PFP as the identity and financing base for a broader anime IP.
strategic_choices.consequence: The collection achieved recognizable brand distribution but tied early trust to a high-price crypto sale.

strategic_choices.choice: Launch the 20,000-item Elementals extension through an existing-holder-heavy sale.
strategic_choices.consequence: The sale generated capital but the execution and art-overlap backlash damaged scarcity and governance credibility.

strategic_choices.choice: Allocate 37.5% of ANIME to the Azuki community while retaining separate team and company allocations.
strategic_choices.consequence: NFT ownership received token participation, while unlocks and ecosystem execution became additional risks.

strategic_choices.choice: Build a physical TCG, organized-play network and manga rather than rely only on NFT trading.
strategic_choices.consequence: The brand gained observable non-NFT distribution and a more durable product test, but also inventory, retail and content-production obligations.

counterfactual.finding: A smaller or staged Elementals release with clearer differentiation and public-sale controls could have reduced dilution and trust damage. Conversely, never expanding beyond the original NFTs would have protected scarcity while leaving the business more exposed to secondary-market contraction. Neither alternative proves a better financial outcome.

risks.risk: Historical founder and Elementals disputes continue to raise execution and governance risk.
ANIME allocations and unlocks create a separate token-supply and incentive system around the NFT community.
Physical TCG and manga expansion require retail demand, repeat play and content execution not proven by launch announcements alone.

profile_patch.community_history: CloneX began as RTFKT and Takashi Murakami's 20,000-avatar project, followed within weeks by Nike's acquisition of RTFKT. Nike later approved an operational wind-down effective January 2025. The current RTFKT site is an archive and the collection remains transferable on external markets; those survivals do not restore the operator product that issued wearables and experiences.
profile_patch.community_sentiment: No representative current sentiment survey is available. Litigation alleges a soft rug and holder harm, but allegations are not findings and the case outcome is unresolved in the reviewed evidence.
profile_patch.notable_holders: No current independently verified named-holder roster is asserted. CoinGecko's unique-owner count is wallet-level telemetry, not identity verification.
profile_patch.founder_engagement: RTFKT's operating company ceased services under Nike's wind-down. An archive and status surface remain online; the identity, authority and operating plan of any post-sale steward are not established here.
profile_patch.social: RTFKT archive and status pages remain reachable, but archive availability is not evidence of an active product roadmap or support team.
profile_patch.benefits: Historical benefits included 3D avatar files, RTFKT wearables, sneakers and experiences. Current continuing entitlements, support obligations and redemption programs are not verified.
profile_patch.business: The RTFKT operating model combined avatar sales, digital wearables, physical-linked sneakers and Nike ownership. Nike chose to wind operations down while preserving an archive. Collection trading persists externally, but current operator revenue, staffing, service obligations and product cadence are withheld.
profile_patch.analysis: Dead is scoped to the original operator product, not the token contract or art. The decisive event is Nike's approved operational wind-down, demonstrating concentration risk when NFT utility depends on a corporate parent and hosted services. The archive and external trading preserve provenance and transferability but do not constitute continued RTFKT operations.

products_and_value_capture.capture: Historical mint and commerce occurred; current operator revenue and ongoing holder value delivery are withheld because operations ended.

chain_dependence.finding: Ethereum preserves token ownership, while files, storefronts, redemption systems and product support depended on RTFKT-hosted or corporate services. The wind-down shows that on-chain provenance does not guarantee off-chain utility continuity.

why.finding: CloneX failed at the operating-product layer because its utility and delivery organization became concentrated inside a corporate parent that chose to exit. The acquisition provided brand and distribution potential, but holders had no control over Nike's later resource-allocation decision.

strategic_choices.choice: Launch a high-priced avatar collection tied to a broad digital-fashion roadmap.
strategic_choices.consequence: RTFKT financed an ambitious product surface while making ongoing value dependent on future delivery.

strategic_choices.choice: Sell RTFKT to Nike weeks after CloneX launched.
strategic_choices.consequence: The project gained a global parent and then inherited the parent's unilateral portfolio and shutdown risk.

strategic_choices.choice: Depend on hosted archives, files and product services in addition to Ethereum ownership.
strategic_choices.consequence: The NFTs remained transferable, while portions of user experience and utility could end with the operator.

strategic_choices.choice: Wind operations down while leaving an archive.
strategic_choices.consequence: Historical material remained accessible but product cadence, support and new value delivery ceased.

counterfactual.finding: An independent foundation, funded maintenance reserve, portable metadata and enforceable service commitments could have reduced parent-exit risk. They could not guarantee consumer demand or prevent a strategic shutdown, and the reviewed record does not show that Nike considered those structures.

profile_patch.community_history: Doodles grew from an Ethereum PFP collection into an entertainment company, adding acquired creative studios, digital collectibles, consumer collaborations, a Solana token and DreamNet. Its current site shows a live AI creation surface, commerce, community auditions and agency work. That breadth proves continued operation, not that every prior roadmap or holder expectation was delivered.
profile_patch.community_sentiment: No representative holder-sentiment survey is available. Current community auditions and creation tools show an open participation surface, while price reactions or selected social posts are not treated as community-wide sentiment.
profile_patch.notable_holders: Historical celebrity purchases are not used as a current success metric. No current verified named-holder roster is asserted.
profile_patch.founder_engagement: Doodles remains operational under its current company and creative leadership, with Doodles AI, community auditions, branded content, product commerce and $DOOD links on the official site. Exact founder roles and current headcount are not inferred.
profile_patch.social: Official site, auditions and creation tools are live. Follower totals, active-user counts and engagement quality are withheld without reproducible telemetry.
profile_patch.benefits: Original-collection ownership carries licensed display rights and had a disclosed $DOOD allocation process. Current auditions can feature submitted OG Doodles in content, merchandise or campaigns, but selection and rewards are discretionary rather than guaranteed holder yield.
profile_patch.business: Doodles operates an entertainment and creative-services model spanning original content, Golden Wolf agency work, Take Your Medicine audio, brand campaigns, AI creation, collectibles and physical goods. These are observable products and distribution channels; consolidated revenue, profitability and NFT-holder value capture are not public in the reviewed sources.
profile_patch.analysis: Middling separates operating-company health from NFT investment performance. Doodles has real products, partners, commerce and creative infrastructure, but the strategy has repeatedly expanded the product and token surface faster than public unit economics. The key test is whether agency, consumer and AI distribution creates recurring demand and benefits that are meaningfully connected to original-collection ownership.

chain_dependence.finding: The original NFTs and ownership licenses are rooted in Ethereum, while $DOOD and DreamNet extend the strategy to Solana. Consumer products and creative services reduce dependence on either chain but make execution more organizationally complex.

why.finding: Doodles survived by converting recognizable visual IP into an operating creative company with partners, tools and commerce. Its constraint is strategic diffusion: NFTs, studios, AI, tokens, worlds and consumer goods all compete for capital and attention, while public evidence does not show which layer compounds value for original holders.

strategic_choices.choice: Keep core media IP at the company while granting owners limited display rights.
strategic_choices.consequence: Doodles preserves centralized brand control but constrains independent commercialization by holders.

strategic_choices.choice: Build and acquire creative-production capabilities beyond NFTs.
strategic_choices.consequence: Agency, audio and brand work diversify distribution while increasing operating breadth and integration risk.

strategic_choices.choice: Launch $DOOD on Solana rather than the collection's Ethereum home.
strategic_choices.consequence: The token accesses Solana distribution but splits the ecosystem across chains and adds claim and incentive complexity.

strategic_choices.choice: Use OG Doodles in auditions and community-led content.
strategic_choices.consequence: Selected holders can participate in IP production, but benefits are curated and not guaranteed to all owners.

counterfactual.finding: A narrower NFT-and-licensing strategy would reduce execution sprawl but surrender agency, AI and consumer distribution. A more permissive holder-commercialization license could encourage external building while weakening centralized brand control. The reviewed evidence cannot determine which model would produce better economics.

Remilia's current record shows 2026 raves, fashion collaborations, streetwear, a publication project and repeated RemiliaNET releases. The evidence supports cultural and operator continuity; it does not validate every claim made by Remilia about its own history.
profile_patch.community_sentiment: The community remains visibly active through events and network releases, but no representative sentiment or retention survey is available. Remilia's own framing of past controversy is treated as a partisan primary source, not an independent resolution.
profile_patch.notable_holders: Prominent public uses of Milady imagery are historically reported, but no current verified named-holder roster is asserted and social-media avatars do not prove continuing ownership.
profile_patch.founder_engagement: Charlotte Fang and Remilia remain publicly active through RemiliaNET, events, apparel and publishing. The founder's historical controversy remains a reputational and partnership risk rather than being erased by current activity.
profile_patch.social: Remilia's official blog published multiple dated 2026 project and event updates. Audience size and engagement quality are not asserted.
profile_patch.benefits: Milady functions as an identity and access layer across a copyleft remix culture, Remilia community, events and network experiments. CULT and affiliated tokens are separate risk assets; no yield or guaranteed access value is asserted.
profile_patch.business: Remilia operates as a culture and media network with NFTs, RemiliaNET, events, fashion, apparel and publishing. The activity is current and diversified, while consolidated revenue, profitability, token economics and NFT-holder-specific capture remain undisclosed.
profile_patch.analysis: Thriving means the cultural/operator system is producing current releases and events four years after mint, not that Milady is a safe investment or every holder is profitable. The project's resilience comes from a remixable identity and self-propagating community rather than promised financial utility. That same founder-centric, controversy-tolerant culture limits institutional partnership and leaves material conduct risk.

profile_patch.community_history: DeGods built a founder-led Solana community, migrated across chains, returned toward Solana, and added $DEGOD conversion. Founder Rohun Vora resigned in May 2025 and named community successors. The current official site still offers NFT-holder raffles and a reversible DeGods-to-$DEGOD swap, proving residual operation without establishing recovered growth or financial health.
profile_patch.community_sentiment: No representative current sentiment survey is available. Founder departure and migration/token pivots are documented stressors; continued holder raffles show participation but not community-wide satisfaction.
profile_patch.notable_holders: No current independently verified named-holder roster is asserted. Social profiles and wallet labels are not treated as verified identities.
profile_patch.founder_engagement: Founder Rohun Vora resigned in May 2025 and named @0x_chill and @pastagotsauce as successors. Current official holder products continue, but team identities, staffing, treasury authority and operating budget are not fully disclosed.
profile_patch.social: The official site maintains community profiles, a wiki, conversion tools and Dusties raffles. Audience counts and retained engagement are withheld.
profile_patch.benefits: Current NFT holders can claim Dusties raffle tickets and some DeGod traits receive boosts. DeGods can also be reversibly swapped into a disclosed amount of $DEGOD; this adds liquidity optionality without guaranteeing value.
profile_patch.business: DeGods currently combines NFT identity, holder raffles, community media and a $DEGOD conversion/token layer. The observable product is active, but current revenue, treasury, payroll, token-market depth and sustainability are not disclosed.
profile_patch.analysis: Middling corrects both overstatement and understatement. DeGods is not dead: current holder raffles and a reversible conversion product operate after the founder transition. It is not proven thriving: repeated chain and token pivots, founder concentration and unknown economics make the current system fragile. The central strategic lesson is that constant reinvention can preserve attention while destroying comparability, rarity expectations and trust.

profile_patch.supply: 15,000 intended; current surviving supply requires cross-chain and burn reconciliation
profile_patch.royalties_enforced: none under the DeLabs zero-royalty strategy; current marketplace implementation varies
profile_patch.community_history: y00ts launched as DeGods' sister collection, moved from Solana to Polygon and later toward Ethereum, and now sits inside the $DEGOD consolidation strategy. The official converter requires y00ts to be burned for 120,000 $DEGOD, unlike the reversible DeGod swap. However, the current Dusties product still recognizes y00t traits and NFT holders. The collection is therefore declining, not proven extinct.
profile_patch.community_sentiment: The asymmetric burn conversion and founder departure are material negative signals, but no representative current sentiment survey exists. Residual holder perks show that remaining owners have not been wholly abandoned.
profile_patch.notable_holders: No current independently verified named-holder roster is asserted. Cross-chain wallets and burn conversions prevent simple owner-count comparisons.
profile_patch.founder_engagement: Rohun Vora resigned from DeGods and y00ts in May 2025 and named successors. Current DeGods-operated tools still include y00ts, but a separate y00ts team, treasury and roadmap are not disclosed.
profile_patch.social: y00ts appears in the current official converter and Dusties FAQ. A distinct current y00ts publication cadence or independent product surface was not verified.
profile_patch.benefits: Remaining y00ts holders can receive Dusties raffle tickets as NFT holders, and selected y00t traits receive boosted odds. Holders may also irreversibly burn each y00t for 120,000 $DEGOD; this is an exit mechanism, not guaranteed value.
profile_patch.business: y00ts has no independently evidenced operating business in the reviewed current sources. It functions as a residual collection within DeGods holder products and as burn inventory for $DEGOD consolidation. Revenue, treasury, staffing and remaining supply are withheld.
profile_patch.analysis: Declining replaces the legacy dead claim because current official evidence contradicts total extinction: y00ts traits still receive holder utility. The directional risk is nevertheless clear. A burn-only conversion reduces surviving supply and subordinates the collection to $DEGOD, while DeGods retain reversible optionality. That strategic asymmetry can consolidate liquidity for the parent ecosystem at the expense of an independent y00ts identity.

chain_dependence.finding: y00ts moved from Solana to Polygon and then toward Ethereum before being linked back into a Solana $DEGOD ecosystem. Repeated migrations fragmented provenance and community continuity; the burn path now permanently removes NFTs rather than bridging them.

why.finding: y00ts lacked an independent product and leadership layer strong enough to resist parent-ecosystem consolidation. Chain grants and migrations created temporary distribution opportunities but trained holders to absorb repeated coordination costs. Burn-only conversion now prioritizes unified $DEGOD liquidity over y00ts continuity.

strategic_choices.choice: Launch y00ts as a sister collection sharing DeLabs leadership and DUST economics.
strategic_choices.consequence: The project inherited DeGods distribution but never developed clearly independent governance or revenue.

strategic_choices.choice: Migrate from Solana to Polygon under a grant and later move toward Ethereum.
strategic_choices.consequence: Pursued new distribution while imposing repeated holder coordination and weakening chain-native identity.

strategic_choices.choice: Offer only a burn conversion into $DEGOD.
strategic_choices.consequence: Concentrates liquidity and reduces surviving y00ts supply while denying holders the reversible optionality offered to DeGods.

strategic_choices.choice: Continue limited y00ts eligibility inside Dusties.
strategic_choices.consequence: Preserves residual utility and proves the collection is not fully terminated, without establishing a standalone roadmap.

counterfactual.finding: Independent governance, a separate treasury and a reversible conversion could preserve y00ts identity and holder optionality. Staying on one chain could reduce coordination costs. Those alternatives might also fragment parent-ecosystem liquidity and do not guarantee renewed demand.
